NONE: vocabulary

C: A2 [ C ] all the words known and used by a particular person
詞彙量；（某人掌握的）全部詞彙
C or U: C1 [ C or U ] all the words that exist in a particular language or subject
（某一語言或學科的）詞彙，術語

example: a wide/limited vocabulary
詞彙量很大／有限
By the age of two a child will have a vocabulary of about two hundred words.
孩子到兩歲時掌握的詞彙大約有兩百個。
Every week our Spanish teacher gives us a list of vocabulary (= words) to learn.
每週我們的西班牙語老師都會讓我們學一大堆詞彙。
Computing, like any subject, has its own vocabulary.
電腦科學像其他學科一樣擁有自己的專業詞彙。

NONE: › relating to or produced by the voice, either in singing or speaking
嗓音的；發聲的
› often expressing opinions and complaints in speech
喜歡暢所欲言的；直言不諱的
› the singing in a piece of popular music
（流行音樂中的）演唱部分

example: a piece of vocal music
一部聲樂作品
The six principal roles in this opera have an average vocal range of two octaves.
這齣歌劇裡六個主要角色的平均音域覆蓋兩個八度。
He had always been a very vocal critic of the president.
他一直都直言不諱地批評總統。
During these years, suffrage demands by women became increasingly vocal.
那些年，女性要求獲得投票權的呼聲越來越高。
The vocals are shared by two members of the band.
演唱部分由樂隊中的兩名成員共同完成。
Who is that on vocals (= singing)?
唱歌的人是誰？

NONE: › a pair of folds at the upper end of the throat whose edges move quickly backwards and forwards and produce sound when air from the lungs moves over them
聲帶
› a person who sings, especially with a group who play popular music
歌手；（尤指）流行樂隊的主唱

example: She won the Grammy Award for Best Female Vocalist.
她贏得了葛萊美最佳女歌手獎。

NONE: › to express feelings or ideas in words
說出；用言語表達

example: Most patients find it very difficult to vocalize feelings of shame.
大多數病人都覺得羞恥感很難說出口。

NONE: C2 a type of work that you feel you are suited to doing and to which you should give all your time and energy, or the feeling that a type of work suits you in this way
（值得投入所有時間和精力的）職業，工作；（認為某種職業適合自己的）使命感

example: I feel I've found/missed my true vocation.
我覺得找到／錯過了真正適合自己的職業。
Most teachers regard their profession as a vocation, not just a job.
大多數老師把他們的職業看作是一種使命，而不僅僅是一份工作。
To work in medicine, you should have a vocation for it.
要從事醫務工作，你就要有一種使命感。

NONE: C1 providing skills and education that prepare you for a job
職業的；業務的

example: The Swedes regard vocational training as a part of a youngster's education.
瑞典人將職業訓練視為年輕人應受教育的一部分。

NONE: › a school where students learn skills that involve working with their hands
職業學校
› Vociferous people express their opinions and complaints loudly and repeatedly in speech, and vociferous demands, etc. are made repeatedly and loudly.
大聲疾呼的；大聲叫喊的；喧嚷的

example: Local activist groups have become increasingly vociferous as the volume of traffic passing through the village has increased.
隨著途經村子的車輛不斷增加，當地激進主義團體的抱怨聲也越來越大。
A vociferous opponent of gay rights, he is well-known for his right-wing views.
他是同性戀權利的公開反對者，以其右翼觀點而聞名。
